memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks to shop, manages jewellery counter.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (recall 2, clock draw normal) – negative screen.
falls: No falls in past year; gait steady; TUG 10 seconds – within normal.
medicines: 0 regular.
mood: Reports occasional worry about business, denies depression.
carers: Wife Priya, spouse.
goals: "I want to stay active and keep my shop open."

memories.text:
function: Still independent, walks 20 mins daily, reports mild knee discomfort after standing.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 – negative.
falls: No falls; gait slightly antalgic right; TUG 11 sec – normal.
medicines: 4 regular (amlodipine, telmisartan, atorvastatin, aspirin).
mood: Good, denies anxiety.
carers: Wife Priya, spouse.
goals: "I want to keep walking without knee pain."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Treadmill test: Bruce protocol, stopped at stage 3 due to mild exertional chest discomfort (2/10).
Peak heart rate 132 bpm (85% age-predicted).
ST segment depression 1 mm at V5-V6, resolving within 3 min of recovery.
Blood pressure response normal.
Interpretation: Positive for inducible myocardial ischemia.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Limited by exertional chest discomfort; avoids climbing stairs.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 – negative.
falls: No falls; gait cautious; TUG 12 sec – borderline raised fall risk.
medicines: 4 regular (amlodipine, telmisartan, rosuvastatin, aspirin).
mood: Frustrated, denies depression.
carers: Wife Priya, spouse.
goals: "I want to be able to walk to the market without chest pain."

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-02-20 at 10:30 with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) for follow-up review.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Improved, walks 15 mins without chest pain, occasional mild knee ache.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 – negative.
falls: No falls; gait steadier; TUG 11 sec – normal.
medicines: 7 regular (amlodipine, telmisartan, rosuvastatin, aspirin, metoprolol, isosorbide mononitrate, GTN SOS).
mood: Content, denies anxiety.
carers: Wife Priya, spouse.
goals: "I want to maintain this level of activity and reduce medicines if possible."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Referral to Dr Suresh Reddy, Cardiologist, Narayana Health, Bengaluru.
Reason: Persistent exertional chest discomfort despite optimal medical therapy, positive treadmill test.
Request: Further evaluation, consider coronary angiography and possible revascularization.
Enclosed: Recent ECG, treadmill report, medication list.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Cardiology review completed 2026-08-28.
Coronary angiography shows 70% stenosis in mid LAD, amenable to PCI.
Patient underwent drug-eluting stent placement to LAD on 2026-08-30 without complications.
Discharged on dual antiplatelet therapy (aspirin 75 mg OD, clopidogrel 75 mg OD) plus beta-blocker, statin, ACE inhibitor.
Advised to continue cardiology follow-up in 3 months.
